name: Teal spot
blurb: Teal ramp, hard drop shadow, floating extras
mechanism: A single white object in one fixed oblique projection, teal only on its right-facing sides, outlined in 1.2 px dark teal and dropped onto flat grey by a hard, unblurred deep-teal shadow that always falls down and to the right.

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: every outline, glyphs on pale faces

palette.name: Deep teal
palette.role: hard shadows, sparkles, dark glyphs, right side of teal parts

palette.name: Teal dark
palette.role: front and left sides of teal parts, recess walls

palette.name: Teal
palette.role: right side of white parts, accent tops, LEDs, highlighted UI rows

palette.name: Mid teal
palette.role: sides of pale parts, recess floors, coin sides

palette.name: Pale teal
palette.role: key and card sides, highlight streaks on white

palette.name: White
palette.role: hero top, front and left faces; card tops; glyphs on teal

palette.name: Grey dark
palette.role: right side of small grey parts

line: #0e3f3d outlines at 1.2 px (UI 1.0-1.1, LEDs 0.8), round joins; plate sides drawn with a 2.9 ink stroke behind; no gradients or blur.
rules: One hero object, no people, in the fixed -25/36 degree projection.
White top and front faces; teal only on right-facing sides.
Every shadow is hard, flat #0e4a48 and falls down-right.
Two to four floating extras, each with its own hard shadow.
Three deep-teal sparkles and up to three pale arc ticks.
Group centred, 58-90% of the card wide, 30 px margins.
